name: kat-argon2id-rfc9106

graded_by.test: harness/rigs/vault-vectors.sh — rig-vault-vectors: runs this vector through the deployed browser module in Chromium and requires every selected case to pass

description: Argon2id's known answer from its standard, RFC 9106 §5.3: password 32 × 0x01, salt 16 × 0x02, secret 8 × 0x03, associated data 12 × 0x04, t=3, m=32 KiB, p=4. It sets a secret and associated data, which TSB's chain never uses and some libraries cannot take, so each implementation checks this file or kat-argon2id-reference as it can (OPEN-1.7 (c), ruled 2026-10-29). Published e4: reference, graded by the implementations of the chain's argon2id steps (U6's Go test code, U7, U8c), tests owed (phase 16 names them).

doc.source: RFC 9106 §5.3, Argon2id version 19 (memory 32 KiB, 3 passes, 4 lanes)
doc.checked_by: an implementation that takes Argon2's secret K and associated data X (the reference C code, golang.org/x/crypto/argon2 does not); one that cannot checks kat-argon2id-reference
